There are innumerable ways, but I believe this will distract me for a while but at the of the day, I will have to face the reality and deal with it. There can be any sort of reason for me feeling low. Personal, emotional, academical or whatever. These failures and disappointment ignites something inside and I become more goal oriented. I find my motivation in my failures. I find motivation in rejections. I find motivation in humiliation. I find motivation in disappointments. I find motivation in awkwardness. I find motivation in silence. Negatives get inside me and push me to work harder than before. Constant self doubt and fear of failure keeps me going. Your past situation should never be a deciding factor for your tomorrow. Constantly work on changing your present, so that your tomorrow can be better. Question: How did one experience change your view of life?
Old_Answer: I finished writing my exams this week only. I am on a break for a week, then again grind will begin. So, my sister has a coloring book and once in a while when I am bored I borrow the book from her and fill colours in it. Yesterday, I was coloring this picture. Did you find anything new ? No, right ? Just a ship 🚢 seems sailing in the sea. But, while I was coloring this picture, it made me to look at life with a different perspective. Below are the observations that I made while coloring the picture - Can u see in the picture, the windows lane of the ship. Only windows are colored. While coloring I was confused which color to fill in. I thought it for a while. Then, I decided k I will complete the picture first and then will think of it later. Once I was done coloring the picture, I again started to think of a color which would look good. I was thinking, thinking. But, after sometime I realized that it looks better uncolored. That void space is complementing the whole picture. Even if I add a color, it will seem crowded. This is the case with our life. Sometimes we often ponder upon things, why certain things happened the way it did ? why I did not get what I wanted ? what if I was this and that ? We waste our precious time while looking for answers to this question. But we fail to realize that somethings don't have or even don't need an answer. It's better if they are left the way they are. Constantly putting an effort to such things will take away our mental piece and will not yield anything. If left the way they are, they will definitely add beauty to your life. 2. Value people who care and love you. Can you see the clouds in the picture ? What color is it in the cloud ? Blue right ? Yes, certainly there is a blue color filled in the clouds. But, after filling the blue color, I put white color on it, just to add a gradient and make it look more pretty. But you can't see it ,right ? That's what role our loved ones play in our life. We may not everytime recognize and appreciate there presence but certainly they are there, adding beauty and value to our life. They are the ones who constantly keep us in there prayers and blessings. They would never want anything wrong for us. They will just stay, without you even knowing. So, value them. Appreciate there presence. Tell that you love them. Thank them for there presence. It will definitely make them happy. 3. Some mistakes can't be erased You see the steam coming out of the ship. As I started coloring the clouds, I mistakenly thought that steam is a cloud too. I colored the steam with blue 🤦‍♀️. Then I realized that it's not a cloud. It made me upset for few seconds. So, I thought I will just try to erase the blue. I end up using half eraser to rectify the error. Color did fade away but not too much, it was still visible. While erasing, the page many a times came on the verge of breaking. So, I thought let's just put another color on it. I thought to put brown. But still blue is visible. But how does that matter ? it's okay. ̶M̶i̶s̶k̶a̶t̶e̶s̶, Mistakes are part of you. It doesn't make you any worse. It's not the mistake that matters, it's how you deal with it, what you learn from it and how you apply the lesson in your life. Take chances, make mistakes. That's how we grow. Mistakes are what we often call them experience later. Few years later these mistakes will be your strength, learned lessons and will give you a sense of pride that you made it through. So, it's okay to make mistakes, unless you don't repeat them and you don't learn from them. 4. Broken but beautiful ❤ While coloring the picture, my sister who was also coloring besides me, broke a crayon :( . She - Yaar, I broke a crayon man. I - What difference does that make ? It still colors the same. She - Okay, okay. Don't give me gyaan. I know. I - Huh, whatever. The broken still colors the same. Infact, the edges of it, became more sharper than before, which allowed to color easily at narrow spaces. How beautiful is this ? Broken but beautiful ❤. This is what makes life more beautiful. Somethings at some point of time seems broken to us. But, eventually we realize that the healing process made something very beautiful out of broken. All of your mistakes, worries, failures, define you. They are a part of you. Embrace them. They add meaning to your life. Make them worth your efforts. We do not see things as they are, rather we see things as WE ARE 💞. Our thoughts shape our vision. We see what we choose to see. It's just the matter of perspective.
